<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex71032026-10-1510-01-34" status="unreviewed"> 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs> na re zag pa ni sgra don snang pa'i yin la de dang bcas par bsngo pa la sgro ba la byed pa yin la nges s'byed bha mthun rang don kyi mos pa yod la bdun pa man chad na gnti ga'i mos pa rnam par dag pa brgyad pa yan chad na's || des dbyen pa zag med yin no || de yang sgrub pa'i gnaM ma mad rnam pan dag pa'i sgom lam ra yin no zer ba la
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="34a5"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re de ltar nas brgyad pa zag pa dang bcas pa'i skeng sem rtan N pa thal | 'du shes kyi yul mtshan mang ma bsung par rtog pa mi 'byung pas | rtog pa de 'dra ba'i khyab byed mtshan mang 'dzin pa log pa'i phyir ro || 'dod pas kyang mi nus te btan thug spong su nges pa'i mes pa lasogs pa yod par bshad pas so || 
               
               'di yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs> gis rtog pa dngos su 'byung pa ma den sre byed rang la slo rtse rtad la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs>s gzung 'dzin 'byung du rung pa
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="34a6"/> tsam la zag pa'i blo rtse rtad pa'o gsung so || </seg></TEI>
